Compute Qini Area Under the Uplift Curve (AUUC / Qini)

Source: R/cate_and_sim.R
qini_auc.Rd

Evaluates treatment-prioritization performance of predicted CATE scores against doubly-robust pseudo-outcomes (or observed outcomes).

Usage

qini_auc(cate_fit, pseudo_outcome = NULL)

Arguments

cate_fit

A "tmle_cate" object (or numeric vector of CATE predictions).

pseudo_outcome

Optional numeric vector of pseudo-outcomes (defaults to cate_fit$phi when cate_fit is a "tmle_cate" object).

Value

A 1-row tibble::tibble() with columns .metric, .estimator, and .estimate (qini_auc and auuc).

Examples

df <- sim_causal_cohort(n = 150, outcome_type = "continuous", seed = 42)
fit <- tmle_spec(y, a, c(age, sex, lab_1, lab_2)) |>
  set_resamples(v_folds = 3L) |>
  fit(df)
cate <- fit_cate(fit, v_folds = 3L)
qini_auc(cate)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>   .metric  .estimator .estimate
#>   <chr>    <chr>          <dbl>
#> 1 qini_auc standard     -0.0251
#> 2 auuc     standard      0.954
